Yapper roles

These are Yapper roles inspired by common community-chat roles.

👑 OwnerPermanent, exclusive to ambrosewang@westminster.net. Full control of roles, bans and chat administration. Only the Owner can ban or unban members.
🛡️ AdminRemove group conversations and request member-role changes. Requests require Owner approval; Admins cannot assign Admin or Owner.
🔨 ModeratorCommunity moderation role. Moderation actions beyond the features shown in this version are not yet implemented.
🤝 HelperHelps answer questions and guide members; no extra technical permissions in this version.
💎 VIPA recognition role; no extra technical permissions in this version.
👤 MemberStandard account: find people, join conversations, and send messages.
🔇 MutedCan read accessible conversations but cannot send messages.
🚫 BannedRemoved from Yapper by the Owner. A banned account cannot sign in, read, or send messages until it is unbanned.
